prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Reference image is the approved STYLE REFERENCE, not a scene to copy literally. Match its exact basic traditional classroom flannel-board style: a few flat hand-cut craft felt shapes, face-on orthographic view, limited solid colors, subtly fuzzy actual wool fabric, slightly imperfect scissor-cut edges, only tiny overlap shadows. Realistic as an ordinary handmade classroom craft, NOT a sculpted miniature, NOT a digital glossy 3D illustration. Absolutely NO intricate detail, embroidery, stitching, realistic room perspective, cinematic lighting, atmospheric glow, plush stuffing or decorative embellishments. No text, no labels, no border or outside edge of board. Make a full-bleed 16:9 simple felt-board picture of a dark room. Background is one flat muted dark teal felt sheet. Across lower quarter is a flat charcoal-brown felt floor strip. On right, at x65%, one large closed closet door: simple dark purple upright rectangle with a slightly sloping top, a narrow darker purple frame, a central seam and two small round ochre knobs. Door reaches the floor strip, mounted flush to wall. On left just a simple rectangular blue window with four panes, navy crossbar and pale yellow crescent moon outside. No furniture, no curtains, no candles, no extra objects. Broad uncluttered silhouettes just like reference.
